title: In a universally exact sequence with flat middle term the outer terms are flat
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that if a short exact sequence of modules is universally exact and its middle term is flat, then the two outer terms are flat as well (statement lines 20257-20262). The proof does not use a criterion for flatness in terms of ideals: it tensors the given universally exact sequence with an arbitrary short exact sequence, draws the resulting commutative three-by-three diagram with an Xy-pic matrix, records which rows and columns are exact from the two hypotheses, and chases the diagram to get exactness of the tensored sequence at the outer terms (proof lines 20264-20287). Setting up the diagram so that the chase closes is the content of the argument. H2.
